description: Defines a template class PacketNumberIndexedQueue for managing a queue of packet entries indexed by packet number, supporting insertion, removal, and retrieval operations, with internal data structure as a circular deque.

classes.name: PacketNumberIndexedQueue
classes.description: A template class implementing a packet number indexed queue with operations for insertion, removal, and access, optimized for ordered packet processing.

methods.name: GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves the entry associated with a specific packet number.

methods.name: Emplace
methods.description: Inserts a new element into the queue at the specified packet number.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the entry associated with a specific packet number, optionally calling a function on it.

methods.name: RemoveUpTo
methods.description: Removes all entries up to a specified packet number.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Removes unused slots from the front of the internal deque.
